summary.en: Use vertical drawer storage to keep a simple room layout.
summary.zh: 用竖向抽屉收纳保持空间布局简洁。

description.en:
A tall white drawer chest with a clean front arrangement. The vertical format gives you a way to plan separate storage for clothing, accessories and other everyday items.
Confirm the required height, width, drawer hardware and anchoring requirements for the installation space.
description.zh:
高身白色抽屉柜采用简洁正面布局，便于为衣物、配饰及日常物品规划不同收纳位置。
请结合摆放空间确认高度、宽度、抽屉五金及固定要求。

en: White appearance for a simple interior palette.
Dimensions and installation requirements confirmed with the model.
zh: 白色外观，便于简洁空间搭配。
尺寸与安装要求按具体款式确认。

value.zh: 白色外观，高身抽屉布局

value.en: Request model-specific order and sample terms
value.zh: 按款式询价确认起订量及样品条件

value.en: Confirm packing, assembly requirements and current lead time
value.zh: 核对包装、组装要求及当前交期
